## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `ha-config-navigation` (Settings Dashboard Navigation)

**What changed:** A new optional `label` property was added to `HaConfigNavigation`. When `this.label` is provided, it is used as the text content of the `div.visually-hidden[role="heading"]` element instead of always calling `this.hass.localize("panel.config")`. The surrounding `<div class="visually-hidden">` element is preserved; only its inner text source changes. The PR also introduces a new `ha-config-connectivity` panel that groups Bluetooth, Thread, ZHA, ZWave, Matter, Infrared, Radio Frequency, and Serial connectivity panels behind a single "Connectivity" navigation entry (`#53905`).

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The theme targets `ha-config-navigation` indirectly via two card-mod-config selectors:

1. `"ha-config-dashboard $ ha-top-app-bar-fixed ha-config-section" > "ha-card" > "ha-config-navigation $ ha-config-navigation-list$"` — styles `ha-list-item-button` elements with LCARS top/mid/bottom color scheme.
2. `"ha-config-system-navigation $ hass-subpage ha-config-section ha-card" > "ha-config-navigation-list $"` — same list styling for system navigation subpage.

The new "Connectivity" entry is a new navigation group added to the Settings dashboard navigation list. The LCARS list-item color rules use `:first-child` and `:last-child` selectors on `ha-list-item-button`:

```yaml
ha-list-item-button:first-child {
  background-color: var(--lcars-card-top-color);
}
ha-list-item-button:last-child {
  background-color: var(--lcars-card-bottom-color);
}
```

Adding the new "Connectivity" item shifts which list item is `:last-child` (and possibly `:first-child` within its group), potentially re-assigning the `--lcars-card-bottom-color` (gray) to a different item than before. The visual effect is that the bottom-colored "footer" pill in the Settings list will move to a different navigation entry than it previously did.

**Suggested fix:** This is a cosmetic shift in the LCARS pill color assignment, not a breakage. No immediate fix is required unless strict visual consistency of the first/last pill assignment matters. If it does, consider switching to `:nth-child()` selectors with explicit indices, or accept the re-ordering as the natural result of the new Connectivity entry being inserted.

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: `ha-config-navigation` — New `label` Property

**What changed:** The `label?: string` property was added (`#53905`). When set, it overrides the default `"panel.config"` localization string shown in the `div.visually-hidden` heading. The `div.visually-hidden` element itself is unchanged and is not targeted by any ha-lcars card-mod CSS.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. The `div.visually-hidden` element is screen-reader-only (opacity/size clipped by the `.visually-hidden` class), does not render visibly, and is not referenced in any ha-lcars card-mod selector.

### Component: `ha-config-connectivity` — New Connectivity Panel Grouping

**What changed:** Bluetooth, Thread, ZHA, Z-Wave JS, Matter, Infrared, Radio Frequency, and Serial panels are now grouped under a new `ha-config-connectivity` panel accessible at a new route (`#53905`). This means those individual config dashboards now live one level deeper in the navigation hierarchy.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed immediately. The ha-lcars theme does not have any card-mod selectors targeting `bluetooth-config-dashboard`, `thread-config-panel`, `zwave_js-config-dashboard`, `zha-config-dashboard`, `matter-config-dashboard`, `infrared-config-dashboard`, `radio-frequency-config-dashboard`, or `serial-config-dashboard` by name. If future LCARS styling is added for those panels, the new parent component `ha-config-connectivity` will need to be included in the selector chain.

### Component: `ha-more-info-dialog` / `ha-more-info-details` / `ha-more-info-related` — Structural Split

**What changed:** More-info related and details views were split into separate components (`ha-more-info-details`, `ha-more-info-related`) as part of `#53920`. The changed files are listed in "Other files" and no diff is included, so the exact structural change is not visible.

**Suggested fix:** Monitor. The ha-lcars `card-mod-more-info-yaml` block only targets the top-level `.: |` and `$: |` scopes of the more-info dialog and does not use deep shadow-DOM selectors into `ha-more-info-details` or `ha-more-info-related`. No breakage is expected, but if visual regressions appear in the more-info dialog (particularly in the "Related" or "Details" tabs), inspect the new component shadow trees and add targeted selectors as needed.

### Component: `ha-add-to-action-list` — Grouped List Style Migration

**What changed:** The "add-to" action list dialog was migrated to a grouped list style (`#53921`). No diff is included; the file is in "Other files only."

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. Ha-lcars does not have any card-mod selectors targeting `ha-add-to-action-list` by name. The global `card-mod-dialog-yaml` color variable overrides will apply, but no LCARS-specific structural styling exists for this dialog.
